acceptanceCriteria: A recorded trace whose revision is no longer reachable from HEAD can be retired by a named, read-only-safe command, and the loop names that command in its refusal.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews and worker reports of the V1 wave-2 pull requests (#82-#85). PR #83 (V1-0010) and PR #84 (V1-0017): amending after a recorded pass strands a trace revision; the loop then refuses with unsupported-query-trace-state / record-failed and only git surgery recovers.

completion.reason: Owner accepted LTPM-V0-012 on 2026-09-27; the acceptance is recorded in 7dbf98a4 (merged in beamfall/corvint#288 as 1efa4287). The stranded-trace retirement path is implemented experimentally on origin/main.

title: dogfood: no supported command removes a stranded trace revision after an amend or rebase
